Small print under the street line and the 'T03' code are distractors; the small 'Banco Metalli s.r.l.' line is in small caps and slightly soft. An 'OPEN' LED sign on the right is a distractor.

c112502804.notes: Bilingual Italian / Ligurian locality plate on a dry-stone wall in Giustenice (Liguria), slightly soft focus. Ligurian 'Crösu' has an o-umlaut. The tiny 'Comune di Giustenice' text above the crest is not legible and not transcribed.

c113649247.notes: Turin street-name plate at the top right of a traffic-light pole; the traffic lights and the blue 'straight or right' pictogram dominate the frame. Typographic apostrophe in D’Azeglio.

c170652103.notes: Oval fascia of an ice-cream shop over a rusty roller shutter, Viale Giacomo Matteotti 71, Nettuno; 'GELATERIA' left and 'ARTIGIANALE' right of a cone icon. House-number tile '71' on the left pillar. Distractors: menu strips (GRANITA AL CAFFE', BRIOCHE, FRAPPE', CREPES, YOGURT, BANANA SPLIT), ho-mobile.it flag/chalkboard and NOKIA / HUAWEI / SAMSUNG window lettering of the shop next door.

c170926293.notes: Hairdresser in Via Alarico Ciotti, Cisterna di Latina: name printed on the awning valance. A square wall panel above repeats 'PARRUCCHIERIA / HAIR CARE' around a drawn face with a small tagline that is not reliably legible; door decal and doormat repeat the name.

c29798296.notes: Bilingual German / Italian town welcome sign, South Tyrol, with a bicycle pictogram; frame-filling. 'Vipiteno' is the Italian name of the same town.

c25972738.notes: Shoe shop name in decorative script on a white awning, Pianello Val Tidone (Piacenza); pun on 'Carpe diem'. Window posters below (CastelNov... on Air, 1 MAGGIO..., FINE SERIE & Stock) are distractors.

c124195360.notes: Street plate on a pole in Borghetto Santo Spirito, above a one-way arrow and two brown-on-white direction signs 'stadio' and 'carabinieri' (distractors, with a graffiti tag on 'stadio'). No space after 'D.' on the plate.

c151082945.notes: Brown tourist direction sign to the church of Sant'Egidio, Lecco, with two children's drawings and tiny credit text (not transcribed). Above it a locality plate 'località / sant' egidio' (lower case, apostrophe then space) with scribbled graffiti; an ultras sticker on the arrow is a distractor.

c128713255.notes: Small brown post sign at the left edge (cycling pictogram and municipal crest above the text) in front of the nature-centre building, Isola Vicentina; text is small in the frame but legible on zoom.
